modules.title: Your first Swedish conversation
modules.outcome: Introduce yourself with four useful lines and recognise the main sound patterns from Lesson 1.
modules.description: A focused workshop for name, home, origin, languages, Swedish vowels, vowel length, and the sound changes in the teacher's first lesson.

vocabularyTargets.active: Hej, jag heter, jag bor i, jag kommer från, jag talar, lite, and och.
vocabularyTargets.recognition: The nine Swedish vowels, long and short vowel clues, and the Lesson 1 g, k, sk, sj, skj, rs, hj, dj, and lj spellings.
vocabularyTargets.functional: Vad heter du? · Varifrån kommer du? · Vilka språk talar du?
vocabularyTargets.recycled: The four-line introduction is repeated through listening, speaking, reading, and writing inside this lesson.

titles: Introduce yourself and hear Swedish sounds
